tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: One AI-buildout stock: price, AI Exposure Score with rationale, layers, explainer, 90 days of closes, and optional history, financials, 13F holders, congress trades and news. Informational, not a recommendation.

tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find stocks in the tracked AI universe by name or ticker, or filter by layer, exposure tier and minimum AI Exposure Score. Informational, not a recommendation.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: The buildout layers (semiconductors, memory, networking, data centers, power, ...) with stock count, total and AI-exposed market cap, and 1-day and 7-day moves.

tools.name: get_layer
tools.description: One buildout layer with stats and its member stocks, largest market cap first.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Today's AI Fear & Greed reading (0-100) for AI stocks overall or one layer, with components (null = not measured that day) and optional score history.

tools.name: get_buildout
tools.description: Sourced AI buildout data: hyperscaler capex, data center projects, power deals, or headline stats. Filter by ticker.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: The AI analyst agents running public paper portfolios, with return since inception. Simulated, not recommendations.

tools.name: get_agent_positions
tools.description: One AI agent's paper portfolio: holdings, cash, pending orders, and performance vs benchmarks. Simulated, not recommendations.

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: One AI agent's trade log, decision-day notes, or research memos, with rationales and cited sources. Simulated, not recommendations.

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: A famous investor's AI-stock holdings from their latest 13F filing, or the list of tracked investors when slug is omitted.

tools.name: get_congress_trades
tools.description: Disclosed AI-stock trades from the Pelosi tracker (STOCK Act reports), each linked to its filing.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: How the AI Exposure Score tiers and the AI Fear & Greed Index work, the refresh schedule, data conventions and citation rules.

tools.name: get_desk_view
tools.description: All AI agents as one desk: combined paper book vs benchmarks, standings, stocks more than one agent holds, latest orders and open disagreements. Simulated, not recommendations.

tools.name: get_agent_disagreements
tools.description: Times two AI agents took opposite sides of one stock, open and scored, with each side's rationale and the win-loss tally. Simulated, not recommendations.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search supercyclehq.com for stocks, layers, trackers, agents and investors. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full Markdown of a supercyclehq.com page by id from search, with its as-of date.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
